item.title: Monday 10 AM Update, Nov 9
item.description:
The Monday 10 a.m. update from Gumshoe News Radio for November 9, 2026: Londonderry weather through tomorrow; the lame-duck Congress returns with an Epstein-files petition two signatures short and GOP leadership votes tomorrow; Secretary Rubio defends the Iran war as necessary if unpopular; U.S. school closures hit a post-pandemic high; Russell Brand sentenced to ten and a half years; the Turkish steel-plant death toll rises to ten; Novaya Gazeta leaves its Moscow newsroom; who's at the table in Abu Dhabi; stocks rally at the open as Nvidia slides; Tesla robotaxis reach San Antonio; Google's new TPUs and the Elvis and Eminem suits against Suno; an FBI agent's crypto theft and a 7.7 million-customer breach in Japan; your X feed; Senator-elect Pappas and Secretary of State Scanlan; and a surprise right whale calf. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Monday Morning, Nov 9
item.description:
The Monday morning bulletin from Gumshoe News Radio for November 9, 2026: Londonderry weather with the seven-day outlook; President Trump tells 60 Minutes his deportation policy was "too tough" as Stephen Miller starts as chief of staff, the Justice Department and Democrats square off over oversight, and the lame-duck Congress opens with a Hegseth impeachment push and a fight over Senate GOP leadership elections; Qatar's prime minister brings an Iran proposal to the White House, Russia and Ukraine trade heavy strikes before Abu Dhabi talks, the Krakow gunman dies in hospital, and a deadly steel-plant blast in western Turkey; a pre-market look at futures, Nvidia, yields, oil, gold, bitcoin and this week's inflation data; Tesla winds down the Cybertruck; Trump on A.I. guardrails and Anthropic's IPO roadshow; the Web3Auth wallet breach and an LNbits shutdown alert; your X feed; the Wild River Fire and tonight's council budget workshop; and dogs that sniff out invasive plants. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Sunday 1 PM Update, Nov 8
item.description:
The Sunday 1 p.m. update from Gumshoe News Radio for November 8, 2026: Londonderry weather through tomorrow; a homecoming shooting at Winston-Salem State University, and recovery after catastrophic flooding on the Georgia-Tennessee border; Iran says a tanker hit a mine near Hormuz, and Gadi Eisenkot formally receives the mandate to form Israel's next government; a brief weekend markets desk; Apple's new chief presses for a more agent-like Siri; Anthropic's reported generator deal for data-center power; a Botpress breach aimed at A.I. credits; your X feed; this afternoon's events in Londonderry and Plaistow; and a lost budgie found in a storm drain. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.
Chapters: 0:00 Open & Weather 0:55 US News 2:45 International 4:53 Weekend Markets 5:29 Technology 6:25 Artificial Intelligence 7:15 Cybersecurity 8:22 From Your X Feed 9:01 Local News & Events 9:36 Uplifting Story 10:24 Close
Sources: - NWS forecast for Londonderry, NH - National Weather Service forecast for Londonderry, NH (api.weather.gov), retrieved Nov 8 at airtime - AP and NBC News on the Winston-Salem State University homecoming shootings (Nov 8); WXII, "19-year-old killed, woman injured in WSSU shooting; man charged" (updated Nov 8, 12:46 p.m. EST); GEMA/HS, "GEMA/HS Continues Supporting North Georgia Communities as Flood Response Transitions to Recovery" (Nov 8); The Center Square, "Flooded Georgia, Tennessee towns begin recovery; one death reported" (Nov 6), quoting GEMA/HS Director Josh Lamb; AP on the 1-in-1,000-year characterization of the border flooding - Anadolu Agency and Iran International on the IRGC and Iranian navy tanker-mine statements (Nov 7-8); Iran International citing UKMTO on a projectile strike and a separate tanker fire near Musandam (Nov 8); The Jerusalem Post, "Unconventional steps required: Eisenkot vows to form emergency gov't as Herzog bestows mandate" (Nov 8); Times of Israel live blog (Nov 8) - Weekend market indicators via live quotes compiled Nov 8 (bitcoin near $75,900, gold near $4,069, WTI near $91); week-ahead context from the Sunday Morning bulletin - Bloomberg, Mark Gurman, Power On newsletter, as reported by MacRumors, "Siri AI Rumored to Become More Like an Agent as Early as Next Year" (Nov 8) and 9to5Mac (Nov 8) - CNBC, "Anthropic secures $3.4 billion generator deal for AI data centers, FT reports" (Nov 8); Financial Times reporting cited therein; Reuters September 2026 reporting on Anthropic's infrastructure spending plans, as cited by CNBC - Botpress, Michael Masson, "Security incident disclosure — November 2026" (Nov 6) - Harry's X home timeline, Nov 8 (@interesting_aIl, @therealautoblog, @Variety) - HappeningNext Jingle & Mingle listing (Nov 8); Timberlane PAC/TCMA listings for the Nov 8 veterans concert; Londonderry Town Council calendar for the Nov 9 budget workshop; Derry News, "Veterans Day observed throughout region" (Oct 29) - Good News Network, "Lucky Bird Found in Storm Drain a Mile From Home After Passing Driver Happens to Spot it Hopping in" (Nov 8), citing RSPCA / SWNS
